questions.prompt: Which of these goes on forever in both directions?
questions.explanation: A line has no endpoints. A ray goes on forever in one direction only.
95° is a little more than 90°, so it is obtuse. A right angle is exactly 90°.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a reflex angle?
questions.explanation: Reflex angles are between 180° and 360°. 170° is obtuse.

questions.prompt: Two angles on a straight line are 3x and 2x. What is x?
questions.explanation: 3x + 2x = 180, so 5x = 180 and x = 36. Using 360 instead of 180 gives 72.

questions.prompt: Angles at a point are 90°, 130° and b. What is b?
questions.explanation: 90 + 130 = 220 and 360 - 220 = 140. 220 is only the sum of the two you know.

questions.prompt: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. One angle is 63°. What is its alternate angle?
questions.explanation: Alternate angles (the Z shape) are equal. 117° would be the co-interior angle.
